notes.title: Demo Update March
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

I'm thrilled to express my heartfelt gratitude for your wishlists for Vivian and Kyuma!  As I march toward the big release day, I'm delighted to announce that new demo updates are now available.

Thank you once again.

While the story is still progressing, new scenes and gameplay features of Vivian's cultivation activity have been added to the demo.
